Generated Narrative: ImplementationGuide kenya.fhir.core

KenyaCoreImplementationGuide

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://fhir.sha.go.ke/fhir/ImplementationGuide/kenya.fhir.core

Kenya Core FHIR Implementation Guide describes the FHIR profiles, extensions, value sets, and code systems used to support healthcare data exchange in Kenya under the Social Health Authority (SHA).
